The **[Brooklinen Luxe Sateen Core Sheet Set](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462913539506409,imageDocid:8263042305436882897,gpcid:6213749140614199035,headlineOfferDocid:4341272468434085309,catalogid:6330295375735539801,productDocid:14203573419502033635,rds:PC_6213749140614199035%7CPROD_PC_6213749140614199035&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjZtY7D64OYAxW4hf0HHazKOikQxa4PeggIAggBCBAQAQ)** is a perennial favorite in the online bedding world and a past winner of the *Good Housekeeping* Best Bedding Award . Famous for giving your bed a five-star hotel feel, they lean into a rich, silky-smooth finish rather than a crisp, lightweight crispness.[[1]](https://sleepopolis.com/sheet-reviews/brooklinen-luxe-core-sheets-review/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:14203573419502033635,catalogid:6330295375735539801,gpcid:6213749140614199035,mid:576462913539506409&ibp=oshop)

#### The Quick Breakdown

- **Material:** 100% long-staple cotton
- **Thread Count:** 480 thread count
- **Weave:** Sateen (subtle sheen, ultra-smooth hand-feel)
- **Price Range:** ~$144 – $179 depending on size and current promotions via the [Brooklinen Official Store](https://www.brooklinen.com/collections/gs/products/luxe-core-sheet-set?variant=43350204809306&srsltid=AYCX9vI0WWHZWawqglvFnITrM9F3exQL4vATBBOPQ53vjhkv9WWLzxp482I) [[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:14203573419502033635,catalogid:6330295375735539801,gpcid:6213749140614199035,mid:576462913539506409&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://sleepopolis.com/sheet-reviews/brooklinen-luxe-core-sheets-review/)

#### What Users & Testers Love (Pros)

- **Buttery-Soft Hand-Feel:** Right out of the package, the sateen weave feels smooth, dense, and luxuriously satiny against the skin.[[1]](https://sleepopolis.com/sheet-reviews/brooklinen-luxe-core-sheets-review/)
- **Subtle Sheen:** Unlike matte percale sheets, the sateen finish has a slight, elegant luster that elevates the look of the bed.[[1]](https://sleepopolis.com/sheet-reviews/brooklinen-luxe-core-sheets-review/)
- **Thoughtful Tagging:** Brooklinen includes handy "Long Side" and "Short Side" fabric labels on the fitted sheet, ending the annoying struggle of rotating a king or queen sheet the wrong way.
- **Durability:** Long-staple cotton holds up well through repeated laundering, softening even more over time without excessive pilling if cared for properly.

#### The Drawbacks to Keep in Mind (Cons)

- **Warmer Sleepers Beware:** Because sateen is a denser, tighter weave, these sheets trap a bit more warmth than Brooklinen’s Classic Percale line. If you sleep extremely hot or night-sweat heavily, you might find them cozy to a fault.
- **Wrinkle-Prone:** Being 100% cotton without synthetic wrinkle-guards, they will wrinkle if left too long in the dryer.
- **Pricey Investment:** They sit in the mid-to-high tier for direct-to-consumer bedding.[[1]](https://sleepopolis.com/sheet-reviews/brooklinen-luxe-core-sheets-review/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:14203573419502033635,catalogid:6330295375735539801,gpcid:6213749140614199035,mid:576462913539506409&ibp=oshop)

#### Are They Worth It?

- **Buy them if:** You love a heavy, silky, hotel-style drape, prefer a soft-against-the-skin feel rather than crisp cotton, and don't sleep overly hot.[[1]](https://sleepopolis.com/sheet-reviews/brooklinen-luxe-core-sheets-review/)
- **Skip them if:** You are a dedicated hot sleeper who needs maximum airflow (look at percale instead) or prefer a textured, lived-in feel like linen.
